claimText: Conflux AI is a Local Visibility + Trust Platform founded by Tarunjit Biswas and Shouvik Majumdar in Kolkata
humanAssessmentRationale: Confirmed by direct first-party engineering leadership disclosures, active public website, and state business operations.
keyLimitations: Operational scope reflects digital services and custom software; does not constitute audited financial metrics.

claimText: ABC Precision Components Pvt Ltd holds an active ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System Certification for CNC machining
humanAssessmentRationale: Verified against accredited IAF CertSearch registrar database with matching certificate number and active valid date.
keyLimitations: Certificate subject to annual surveillance audit.

claimText: Tata Steel Limited is a publicly listed enterprise registered with the Registrar of Companies in India with CIN L27100MH1907PLC002604
humanAssessmentRationale: Direct match in Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) active company database and stock exchange filings.
keyLimitations: Reflects corporate registration standing; does not audit plant-level operational subsidiaries.

claimText: Ranaghat Agro Processing Ltd is registered under the FSSAI with an active food business operator license in Nadia district
humanAssessmentRationale: Corroborated by state Food Safety and Standards Authority (FoSCoS) portal verification.
keyLimitations: License validity must be verified annually.

claimText: Howrah Heavy Foundry Works manufactures grey iron casting grades FG 200 and FG 260 for industrial pumps
humanAssessmentRationale: Supported by pollution control consent order, manufacturing mill test certificates, and customer metallurgical lab reports.
keyLimitations: Tonnage capacity varies by electric induction furnace cycle.

claimText: Falcon Logistics Pvt Ltd is an active operating company registered with the Registrar of Companies
humanAssessmentRationale: MCA Master Data explicitly lists company status as 'Struck Off' pursuant to Section 248 of Companies Act.
keyLimitations: Status reflects statutory database as of retrieval date.

claimText: Bengal Organic Tea Traders holds valid USDA NOP Organic Certification for European and North American export
humanAssessmentRationale: APEDA / USDA Organic Integrity Database lists the farm certification status as 'Revoked' in 2024.
keyLimitations: Revocation applies to export accreditation; does not inspect uncertified local retail tea.

claimText: Apex Solar Distributing is an exclusive Tier-1 authorized channel partner for SunTech Inverters in West Bengal
humanAssessmentRationale: Principal manufacturer (SunTech) official global dealer portal lists authorization as terminated with public fraud caution advisory.
keyLimitations: Investigation relies on principal manufacturer direct dealer verification.

claimText: Kolkata Chemical Refiners operates a zero-discharge solvent distillation unit in South 24 Parganas with valid WBPCB Consent to Operate
humanAssessmentRationale: State Pollution Control Board public registry records a closure direction issued for operating without valid renewal consent.
keyLimitations: Closure direction documented in official WBPCB appellate docket.

claimText: Siliguri Micro Finance Society is a licensed Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) authorized by the Reserve Bank of India
humanAssessmentRationale: Entity does not appear on RBI's master register of registered NBFCs and is flagged on regulatory alert list.
keyLimitations: Applies strictly to RBI NBFC license, not local non-banking cooperative society registration.

claimText: Bagula Precision Hand Tools produces the highest tensile strength carpentry clamps in Eastern India
humanAssessmentRationale: Claim is subjective superlative marketing copy with zero accredited metallurgical test bench reports or comparative laboratory data.
keyLimitations: No standardized NABL laboratory reports found comparing tensile metrics.

claimText: Malda Mango Exporters Syndicate exported 50,000 metric tonnes of GI-tagged Fazli mangoes to the UK in 2025
humanAssessmentRationale: Directorate General of Commercial Intelligence and Statistics (DGCIS) export customs records show regional totals significantly below claimed volume.
keyLimitations: Customs aggregate data available by HS code, entity-level private airway bills unverified.

claimText: North Bengal Cloud Hosters maintains a Tier-4 uptime fault-tolerant datacenter in Siliguri
humanAssessmentRationale: Uptime Institute certification database contains zero certified Tier-4 facilities registered in Siliguri.
keyLimitations: Local server co-location exists, but formal Tier-4 fault-tolerant accreditation is unsubstantiated.

claimText: Murshidabad Silk Artisans Guild employs 12,000 full-time Baluchari weavers across Kandi subdivision
humanAssessmentRationale: District census and Handloom Board artisan registers count fewer total active loom operators in that subdivision.
keyLimitations: Informal family cottage workers not captured in formal payroll data.

claimText: Kolkata Green Hydrogen Pioneers has commercialized an electrolyzer with 92% electrical efficiency
humanAssessmentRationale: Claim relies solely on an unreviewed founder slide deck; no peer-reviewed whitepaper or independent engineering test data available.
keyLimitations: Proprietary lab claim without third-party physical audit.

claimText: Metro Cold Storage Asansol holds valid ISO 22000:2018 Food Safety Management System certification
humanAssessmentRationale: Certificate was valid between 2020 and 2023 but registrar database marks status as 'Lapsed / Not Renewed' as of 2024.
keyLimitations: Historical compliance established; current operational certification inactive.

claimText: Santipur Handloom Cooperative is the designated procurement agency for West Bengal Tantuja State Emporiums
humanAssessmentRationale: State tender contract expired in March 2025; subsequent annual empanelment was awarded to a distinct district federation.
keyLimitations: Past government vendor standing documented; current contract inactive.

claimText: Purulia Stone Quarries Ltd holds environmental mining lease clearance for Plot 412 in Balarampur
humanAssessmentRationale: State Environment Impact Assessment Authority (SEIAA) records show the 5-year lease expired in 2024 without renewal application.
keyLimitations: Applies specifically to Plot 412 clearance.

claimText: Dooars Valley Timber Mills is an active licensed sawmill under the Jalpaiguri Forest Division
humanAssessmentRationale: Forest Department sawmill gazette lists the unit license as expired following supreme court buffer zone restrictions.
keyLimitations: Relies on West Bengal Forest Department gazette records.

claimText: Midnapore Rice Mills Association operates the official CMR paddy milling portal for Paschim Medinipur
humanAssessmentRationale: Department of Food & Supplies migrated to centralized state e-Paddy procurement platform in KMS 2024-25.
keyLimitations: Historical association role acknowledged; technical portal superseded.

claimText: Eastern Coal Transport Services possesses an accident-free safety record across Raniganj coalfields from 2021 to 2025
humanAssessmentRationale: Company annual safety report asserts zero reportable lost-time incidents, while Directorate General of Mines Safety (DGMS) recorded two inquiry notices.
keyLimitations: Company definitions of lost-time incident conflict with statutory DGMS reporting thresholds.

claimText: Kurseong Organic Estate owns the exclusive trademark rights to the brand name 'Makaibari Hills Tea'
humanAssessmentRationale: Trade Marks Registry records show concurrent opposition proceedings filed by an established legacy tea company claiming prior use.
keyLimitations: Final trademark ownership pending adjudication before High Court IP division.

claimText: Bankura Bell Metal Federation holds the sole GI authorization for Bishnupur Dokra craft marketing
humanAssessmentRationale: GI Registry lists multiple registered user societies in Bankura and Purulia; exclusivity is disputed by rival artisan consortium.
keyLimitations: GI registry grants collective rights, not commercial monopoly to a single entity.

claimText: Kolkata Urban Mobility Tech operates the official passenger ticketing API for West Bengal Transport Corporation ferries
humanAssessmentRationale: Vendor displays a signed MoU on website, but WBTC issued a clarification stating integration is an unapproved pilot.
keyLimitations: MoU validity and pilot scope currently under administrative review.

claimText: Durgapur Sponge Iron Consortium operates with 100% captive solar power generation
humanAssessmentRationale: Company sustainability disclosures claim full solar transition, while state electricity distribution tariff records show substantial grid draw.
keyLimitations: Solar power plant exists, but round-the-clock captive proportion is disputed.

claimText: Conflux AI provides React 18 web development with sub-second First Contentful Paint benchmarks
humanAssessmentRationale: Confirmed by direct first-party technical documentation, public repo architecture, and lighthouse audits, but lacks third-party accredited benchmark lab.
keyLimitations: FCP performance verified on live reference URLs; network conditions vary by client endpoint.

claimText: Nadia Jute Mill Machinery designs spinning frames that reduce power consumption by exactly 22%
humanAssessmentRationale: Stated in first-party catalog and customer brochure; no independent IJIRA (Indian Jute Industries Research Association) report attached.
keyLimitations: Engineering efficiency claim based on internal manufacturer testing.

claimText: Darjeeling Himalayan Coffee Co roasts single-origin Arabica grown exclusively at 5,000 ft elevation
humanAssessmentRationale: First-party packaging and website declare estate altitude; Coffee Board of India does not track private micro-lot elevations.
keyLimitations: Altitude claim corroborated by estate GPS coordinates, not statutory certificate.

claimText: Bengal Heavy Cranes maintains a 24-hour emergency hydraulic breakdown team across all West Bengal highway corridors
humanAssessmentRationale: Advertised in company marketing and fleet brochure; SLA response times cannot be verified through statutory databases.
keyLimitations: Service availability claim; real-world response time subject to local dispatcher dispatch.

claimText: Kolkata Robotics Labs uses a proprietary zero-latency edge visual inference algorithm for textile defect inspection
humanAssessmentRationale: Disclosed on company product website; patent filing is unpublished and no IEEE benchmark paper exists.
keyLimitations: Proprietary IP claim without published academic or patent verification.

claimText: NeoClean Water Technologies was named the fastest growing clean-tech startup in Eastern India in 2025
humanAssessmentRationale: Claim appears on 14 distinct business news and aggregator websites, but all 14 trace verbatim to a single PR Newswire paid press release.
keyLimitations: Syndicated press release propagation; counts as 1 single unverified first-party origin.

claimText: Burdwan Bio-Fertilizers Ltd received the National Agricultural Innovation Award from an international council
humanAssessmentRationale: Repeated on multiple directory sites; award is an unaccredited private paid recognition entity rather than Ministry of Agriculture.
keyLimitations: Commercial vanity award syndicated across secondary PR channels.

claimText: Kolkata Fintech Solutions processes over 10 million daily micro-transactions on its payment switch
humanAssessmentRationale: Multiple blogs repeat the 10 million metric, all citing a single founder interview with no NPCI or bank audit verification.
keyLimitations: Syndicated media repetition without independent financial or banking switch audit.

claimText: Haldia Petrochemical Ancillaries was rated top polymer exporter in Eastern India by TradeToday magazine
humanAssessmentRationale: Identical article republished across 8 local blogs; source is a sponsored advertorial.
keyLimitations: Commercial advertorial content; zero government customs validation.

claimText: Siliguri Cold Chain Logistics operates India's first AI-governed sub-zero vaccine distribution fleet
humanAssessmentRationale: Verified as a syndicated press release distribution with zero National Cold Chain Resource Centre (NCCRC) accreditation.
keyLimitations: Press release claims collapsed into single unverified origin.

claimText: Hooghly Riverfront Steels Ltd operates a manufacturing plant in Tribeni with 500 active employees
humanAssessmentRationale: Trade directory lists 500 employees, whereas EPFO (Employees' Provident Fund Organisation) statutory filing records 62 contributing members.
keyLimitations: EPFO data covers formal registered staff; casual contract labor may account for discrepancy.

claimText: Malda Food Parks Limited is a designated Mega Food Park under the Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI)
humanAssessmentRationale: State industrial development brochure lists the park as functional, while central MoFPI dashboard lists status as 'Under Cancellation / Show Cause'.
keyLimitations: Inter-governmental jurisdictional reporting lag between state and central ministries.

claimText: Kolkata Port Marine Repairs is an accredited ship repair unit registered with Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port
humanAssessmentRationale: Company holds a valid trade certificate, but Port Trust active vendor empanelment list omits entity following audit.
keyLimitations: Local dry dock lease active, formal port vendor empanelment contested.

claimText: Medinipur Agro Seed Corporation is certified to produce foundation paddy seed variety Swarna (MTU 7029)
humanAssessmentRationale: State Seed Certification Agency verified seed plot in 2024, but laboratory seed purity test in 2025 failed germination standards.
keyLimitations: Field certification granted, lot-specific germination failed.

claimText: Asansol Industrial Gases holds valid PESO license for storage of compressed oxygen in bulk cylinders
humanAssessmentRationale: PESO license database shows application 'Under Scrutiny with Query', while district magistrate office issued temporary operational NOC.
keyLimitations: PESO central statutory approval pending despite local administrative NOC.

claimText: Apex Technologies is a registered MSME unit based in Salt Lake Sector V, Kolkata
humanAssessmentRationale: Over 40 distinct registered legal entities named 'Apex Technologies' exist in India; requires exact Udyam Registration Number or legal suffix to disambiguate.
keyLimitations: Entity ambiguity detected. Assessment applies only to Udyam-WB-10-XXXXX.

claimText: Bengal Polyplast operates a high-density polyethylene pipe extrusion unit in Howrah
humanAssessmentRationale: Two distinct entities: 'Bengal Polyplast Pvt Ltd' (Jalan Complex) and 'Bengal Polyplast Industries' (Domjur). Disambiguated by factory address.
keyLimitations: Disambiguation required between partnership firm and private limited company.

claimText: Eastern Tea Traders has been a registered member of the Tea Board of India since 1985
humanAssessmentRationale: Multiple proprietorships trade under this generic business name across Kolkata and Siliguri auctions.
keyLimitations: Buyer license registration requires specific Tea Board Buyer ID.

claimText: National Engineering Works is an approved vendor for Indian Railways wagon components
humanAssessmentRationale: Generic entity name. RDSO vendor directory lists 'National Engineering Works (Howrah)', while similarly named units in Kanpur are unapproved.
keyLimitations: Vendor approval restricted to specific RDSO vendor code.

claimText: Heritage Silks is the proprietary brand owner of certified Bishnupuri silk sarees
humanAssessmentRationale: Trademark class 24 shows multiple co-existing registered marks for 'Heritage' with distinct logos.
keyLimitations: Brand protection strictly limited to registered logo device mark.

claimText: Burn Standard Company Limited was founded in Howrah as a prominent railway wagon and engineering pioneer
humanAssessmentRationale: Historical founding and legacy established by parliamentary gazettes and industrial historical archives, despite subsequent liquidation in 2018.
keyLimitations: Valid as historical record; company was formally dissolved in 2018.

claimText: Santipur has been a recognized center of cotton handloom weaving since the 15th century under the patronage of Nadia royalty
humanAssessmentRationale: Corroborated by Geographical Indication (GI) registry historical documentation and state archaeological records.
keyLimitations: Applies to regional weaving tradition; individual artisan guilds formed in modern era.

claimText: Jessop & Company Limited built the iconic Howrah Bridge cantilever structure in Kolkata
humanAssessmentRationale: Howrah Bridge was fabricated by The Cleveland Bridge & Engineering Co with components supplied by Jessop, Braithwaite, and Burn.
keyLimitations: Jessop was part of the fabrication consortium, not sole contractor.

claimText: Bengal Chemicals was founded in 1901 by Acharya Prafulla Chandra Ray as India's first pharmaceutical company
humanAssessmentRationale: Established by Department of Pharmaceuticals records and official historical archives.
keyLimitations: Historical corporate origin verified; nationalized as a PSU in 1980.

claimText: Dooars commercial tea cultivation commenced in 1874 with the Gazaldoba tea estate plantation
humanAssessmentRationale: Documented in British library gazette records and Tea Board of India historical archives.
keyLimitations: Applies to regional industry genesis; Gazaldoba plantation subsequently reorganized.
